propositions: Path.rglob traversal on Python 3.11 caches directory entries and raises FileNotFoundError when a cached child directory disappears before descent, causing snapshot teardown to fail when concurrent lock release removes tracker directories mid-walk

Ambient Path() factory construction during cleanup selects WindowsPath when os.name is monkeypatched to 'nt' before fixture teardown completes, raising NotImplementedError on POSIX systems under Python 3.11

Recursive snapshot discovery must tolerate only FileNotFoundError for concurrent vanishing entries while re-raising other filesystem errors, and must not be affected by test-scoped os.name monkeypatching

The teardown fixture must recursively discover and remove exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots while preserving unrelated content and read-only publication semantics, independent of concurrent store lock lifecycle
